 **Medals Won**

 (ii)

options.text: a - iii , b - iv , c - ii , d - i
a - ii , b - iv , c - i , d - iii
a - i , b - iii , c - ii , d - iv
a - iv , b - iii , c - i , d - ii

solution:
The correct answer is* *__**A-2, B-4, C-1, D-3**__*__**.**__*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vinesh Phogat** won the **Gold medal in Wrestling Women's Freestyle, 53 kg**. Hence, A matches with 2.
 
• **Bajrang Punia** won the **Gold medal in Wrestling Men's Freestyle, 65 kg**. Hence, B matches with 4.
 
• **Sakshi Malik** won the **Gold medal in Wrestling Women's Freestyle, 62 kg**. Hence, C matches with 1.
 
• **Deepak Punia** won the **Gold medal in Wrestling Men's Freestyle, 86 kg**. Hence, D matches with 3.

• **Commonwealth Games 2022:**__

 __
 
• The 2022 Commonwealth Games, officially known as the **XXII Commonwealth Game**s, took place in **Birmingham**, England from **28 July to 8 August 2022**.
 
• India sent a strong contingent of athletes who competed in various sports, bringing home numerous medals.
 
 
 
• **Wrestling at Commonwealth Games 2022:**__
 
 
• Wrestling is a traditional strength of India at the Commonwealth Games, and Indian wrestlers have consistently performed well in this sport.
 
• The competition included various weight categories for both men and women.
